messages.author: 4a524b7e3012fc77
messages.subject: New devtools user (3 Aug 2014)  having trouble with understanding error 'attempting to set attribute on NULL' Any help much appreciated
parts:
Hi there

Apologies if this is the wrong place to ask for help - if it is could you please just point me in the correct direction.

I've been learning about devtools and roxygen2 for about 2 days now - so probably what I'm doing is stupid.  But I am stumped by an error I get when I try to document a generic function and a method for that function with a simple signature.  I can document the generic function OK, I can add in the method OK, but as soon as I try and add in roxygen2 tags to document the method I get an error and I can't work out what it means :

Error: Failure in roxygen block beginning testrox.r:9
attempt to set an attribute on NULL

The code that causes this is:

#' @title gen1 This should be the title for gen1.
#'
#' @description gen1 This should be the description
#'
#' @details gen1 This should show the detail
#' @param a A numeric
#' @param b Another numeric
#' @export
setGeneric('gen1',def=function(a,b){standardGeneric('gen1')})
#' @rdname gen1
#' @title Try to document the method
#' @description
#'  This is the method description
#' @details
#'  meth This is the method detail
#' @param a A numeric
#' @param b Another numeric
#' @return The vector c(a,b)  
setMethod('gen1',signature=signature('numeric','numeric'),
          definition=function(a,b) {
            message('message from the gen1 method for signature = "numeric","numeric" ',a," ",b)
            return(c(a,b))
          }
)



I have attached a zipped version of the complete minimal 'package' in an attempt to provide a working example of my problem (in case the error is in my DESCRIPTION file or elsewhere).  I say attempt because it did seem to work once (before I added in the @param statements).  But then it stopped working.  Cleaning the workspace, removing the @param statements, stopping and restarting RStudio, deleting the NAMESPACE file and trying again, nothing seems to make it work anymore.

I'll paste in below the full text from the console when I get the error.  I have included a sessionInfo() command output as well.

> dev_mode()
Dev mode: ON
d> load_all()
Loading testrox
d> document()
Updating testrox documentation
Loading testrox
First time using roxygen2 4.0. Upgrading automatically...
Error: Failure in roxygen block beginning testrox.r:9
attempt to set an attribute on NULL
d> sessionInfo()
R version 3.1.1 (2014-07-10)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)
locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=English_Australia.1252  LC_CTYPE=English_Australia.1252  
[3] LC_MONETARY=English_Australia.1252 LC_NUMERIC=C                      
[5] LC_TIME=English_Australia.1252    
attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base    
other attached packages:
[1] testrox_0.1  devtools_1.5
loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
 [1] digest_0.6.4   evaluate_0.5.5 httr_0.4       memoise_0.2.1  parallel_3.1.1
 [6] Rcpp_0.11.2    RCurl_1.95-4.3 roxygen2_4.0.1 stringr_0.6.2  tools_3.1.1  
[11] whisker_0.3-2
d>

If anyone can point me in the right direction I'd be most appreciative.  If there is any additional info I should have provided please let me know.

Many thanks in advance

Geoff

PS : I upgraded to the lasts version of R, RTools and roxygen2 about 2 days ago, so I think I'm all up to date.

messages.subject: Re: New devtools user (3 Aug 2014) having trouble with understanding error 'attempting to set attribute on NULL' Any help much appreciated
parts:
Hmmm, I think this is a bug in automated parameter inheritance, and is
probably the same as https://github.com/klutometis/roxygen/issues/261

Hadley

parts:
Many thanks Hadley for such a quick response.  Now I know it is not me I will get on with my main project and not fret about what I am doing wrong.

Before I got your response I did do a little more experimenting.  I made 3 baby packages with various versions of a generic function (gen1) and attempts to add methods into the documentation using @rdname gen1.  I did manage to get documentation to appear when I added 'silly' methods for other generic functions that already existed (I played around adding silly methods for plot and @rdnaming the documentation into gen1.Rd).  At one stage I even managed to get something to work in a peculiar way, which I thought might be a clue.  My baby package defined gen1, plot(numeric, numeric) and plot(numeric, character) in that order, while the documentation appeared in plot(numeric, character), gen1, plot(numeric, numeric) - ie 1,2 ,3 in the R code became 3,1,2 in the .Rd.  But when I cleaned everything up and restarted Rstudio, everything came out in the right order, and nothing I can do now seems to make it misbehave :-(

I suspect it is something to do with the order things accumulated in my RStudio 'environment' while I was experimenting with sequences of load_all(), document(), and dev_help('gen1') - roxygen and R appeared to have different opinions about what order things had occurred in.  But since I can't reproduce it, that's probably not much help.

Once again, many thanks for responding so promptly, and indeed for the complete devtools / roxygen2 suite of packages.

regards

Geoff
